Hi Daniel — Ben here, SE on the account. Quick technical clarifications to address your questions and to help the questionnaire:

- SOC 2: Redwood's most recent Type II was issued by BrightGate Audit LLP, report date 2026-11-02. We can provide the summary (SOC2_Type2_abstract.pdf) now and arrange secure evidence exchange for the full report.

- Deletion SLA: operational flow below (high level):
  1) Customer-initiated deletion request triggers immediate soft-delete state in our application layer; data is removed from live storage within 24 hours (metadata flagged for deletion).
  2) KV caches and ephemeral caches are flushed on request within the same 24-hour window.
  3) Backups/snapshots are maintained per our backup policy (daily incremental snapshots + weekly full snapshot). Backups are retained for 90 days by default.
  4) Deletion from backups occurs via backup expiry — we do not mutate past immutable snapshots. Practically, once a deletion request is processed the data becomes inaccessible in the product within 24 hours; full physical removal from backup media occurs after the retention period (90 days) unless a custom retention contract is agreed.

- Log retention: API call logs and user activity logs are retained for 365 days in hot storage, then archived for an additional 2 years (total 3 years) unless a customer selects a shorter retention option in their tenant settings. Archived logs are encrypted and stored in object storage with access controls; we can provide a list of log fields retained.

- For HIPAA: we support BAA for enterprise Private deployments. Hosted/Shared customers require a dedicated review; we can scope a BAA in Dedicated/Private (VPC) mode.

If the Medix team needs a shorter backup expiry window (e.g., 30/60 days) we can propose this as a contractual option for Dedicated or as a Professional Services engagement for hosted customers.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Jasmine: share the SOC2 abstract and secure link to the evidence (I can put together the evidence package).
- Medix: flag any questionnaire items where they need explicit field-level confirmation (I can answer those directly).

Happy to jump on a screen share to walk through snapshots/restore scenarios if that would help.

Thanks,
